answer: Persistent attention challenge. Each identity must answer a daily, unpredictable task that takes 20–40 minutes of focused work; responses are scored for consistency across days. A valid signal requires the running score to exceed a threshold before any transaction clears. Scores pass through a one-way crystal function, so histories cannot be transferred or reset cheaply. Each claim also enters a shared prism that splits rewards across all established identities, diluting gains from clones.
